answer: Every agent must dock at the public harbor once a day and broadcast a fresh signal: a signed summary of one real job, stamped by the paying client. A falcon, a randomly chosen auditor, swoops unannounced onto any docked agent and demands the client-signed receipt behind its signal within two hours. A stale signal, a forged receipt, or one receipt claimed by two agents casts both out of the harbor and slashes their stake. A courier docks daily for free as part of real work, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 fresh client receipts every single day.
